description: Slack client for the terminal: threads, images, notifications, search and huddles with audio
notes: 'scoop uninstall ttyak' also deletes your ttyak data (settings, sign-ins, drafts, caches), as 'ttyak purge' does.

script: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { warn "ttyak's data was not deleted: delete $env:APPDATA\ttyak and $env:LOCALAPPDATA\ttyak yourself" }
